description: Retrieves published components from a Figma file, which must be a main file (not a branch) acting as a library.

inputSchema.description: Request to retrieve published components from a Figma file.

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file. This file must be a main file (not a branch key) that acts as a library, as components are published from main files.
file_key.title: File Key

inputSchema.title: GetFileComponentsRequest

name: get_file_components

containing_frame.description: Data on the frame where the component resides; null if not within a frame.
containing_frame.title: Containing Frame

created_at.description: Timestamp (UTC ISO 8601) when the component was created.
created_at.title: Created At

description.description: Description of the component, as provided by the publisher in the Figma UI.
description.title: Description

file_key.description: Key of the Figma file containing this component.
file_key.title: File Key

key.description: Unique global key for the component.
key.title: Key

name.description: Name of the component as it appears in the Figma UI.
name.title: Name

node_id.description: ID of the component node within the Figma file.
node_id.title: Node Id

thumbnail_url.description: URL for a 1024x1024 component thumbnail; null if unavailable.
thumbnail_url.title: Thumbnail Url

updated_at.description: Timestamp (UTC ISO 8601) when the component was last updated.
updated_at.title: Updated At

user.description: User who created or last updated the component.
user.title: User

name.description: Name of the component set node; null if not applicable.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: ID of the component set node; null if not applicable.
nodeId.title: Node Id

backgroundColor.description: Background color of the frame node (RGBA); null if not set or applicable.
backgroundColor.title: Background Color

containingComponentSet.description: Details of the component set for this frame, if applicable; null if not part of a component set.
containingComponentSet.title: Containing Component Set

containingStateGroup.description: Deprecated: Use `containingComponentSet`. Details of the state group for this frame, if any.
containingStateGroup.title: Containing State Group

name.description: Name of the frame node; null if not applicable.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: ID of the frame node containing the component; null if not applicable.
nodeId.title: Node Id

pageId.description: ID of the page containing this frame.
pageId.title: Page Id

pageName.description: Name of the page containing this frame.
pageName.title: Page Name

name.description: Name of the state group node; null if not applicable.
name.title: Name

nodeId.description: ID of the state group node; null if not applicable.
nodeId.title: Node Id

GetFileComponentsResponse.description: Response with published components from the Figma file and request status.

data.description: Structured API response detailing retrieved components and request outcome.
data.title: Data

GetFileComponentsResponse.title: GetFileComponentsResponse

components.description: List of `Component` objects found in the file library.
components.title: Components

meta.description: Contains the list of retrieved components.
meta.title: Meta

status.description: HTTP response status code; 200 indicates success.
status.title: Status

img_url.description: URL of the user's profile image.
img_url.title: Img Url
